note_results: Medium and long-term lines. Germany: Finanzagentur workbook, allotted amount excludes the retention, history since 2015 in data/raw/auctions_de.csv. Spain: Tesoro Publico result pages, archived each day. Italy: MEF result PDFs, single-price auction, so the yield is the yield at the auction price. France: the AFT site refuses automated access, so French results are those read on 19 Nov 2026 and are not refreshed.
note_upcoming: Germany and Spain: issuers' calendars, read each day. France: date from the AFT calendar rule, not from a dated calendar. Italy: no machine-readable calendar found.
